about: Scenarios for `edakit sim`: fresh and used cells x switch on or off x the LED's forward-voltage corners x the spread of U1's discharge resistance and Q1's threshold, and both cells upside down. On, the 555 sits in the phase in which D1 is lit (U1's states in the graph).

fresh.note: two fresh alkaline AAA cells in series: 1.6 V each off load; internal resistance 0.15–0.3 Ohm each fresh (Energizer E92 datasheet) – 0.3 Ohm each

used.note: two alkaline AAA cells used to 1.1 V each, the end voltage of R-1 (D-3); 1 Ohm each assumed – the internal resistance rises as the cell empties, no datasheet gives it

reversed.note: both fresh cells put in upside down – the holder takes them that way

on.about: SW1 on, the 555 in the phase in which D1 is lit

on_reversed.about: SW1 on with both cells upside down: Q1 blocks, D1 stays dark
